exempt.NciCheck.CheckMain: the nci-check exe: reads an instance file and prints NciCheck.Desc.check (or, with --unrolled, NciCheck.check) on it; IO around the audited check, not a proof
exempt.NciCheck.DescDifftestMain: the description-sized check's difftest, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of NciCheck.DescDifftest.main, audited under NciCheck, a test and not a proof
exempt.NciCheck.DifftestMain: the difftest against the Python reference, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of NciCheck.Difftest.main, audited under NciCheck, a test and not a proof

NciCheck.DescDifftestMain.why: 3,659 declarations divided into IUs of root nodes (3,000 random, a quarter of them read across their arrays' rows, 24 on each distinct descriptor of the circuits fixtures, 6 on a composite keyed with an input id, which is no input node, and 2 on a gate reading a nested scan's carry, one of them past NciCheck.Desc.walkBound's limit, and 1 beside a scan of no iterations, which NciCheck.Desc refuses though nothing reads it, then the unrolled difftest's two pinned ones) on which NciCheck.Desc.check gives what scripts/nci_reference.py's check_desc computes, and, on each one it gives a verdict on, what NciCheck.check gives on the instance expanded gate by gate: the description-sized check against the unrolled one

NciCheck.DifftestMain.why: 4,000 random declarations and divisions, and two pinned ones (θ with an input bound per run, refused theta-not-registered, and θ the registered input, accepted), on which NciCheck.check gives what scripts/nci_reference.py computes from Nci.Complies' definitions: per IU its size and novel reads, the verdict and the first failing IU with its rule, or the first malformation's code

NciCheck.Check.why: the check is code: Lean core and C-Flock's program decoder only, no Mathlib and nothing of Security (the coordinator's ruling for this port)

NciCheck.Desc.why: the description-sized check is code, as NciCheck.Check is: Lean core, C-Flock's program decoder and the check's instance format and verdict
